about_the_game:
Gladiator Command is a strategic auto-battler set in the ruthless world of ancient Rome. As the master of a growing ludus, you'll manage a roster of unique gladiators, oversee training regimens, make critical recruitment decisions, and send your warriors into real-time, permadeath combat — all while building a legacy worthy of legend.

This is not a clicker or idle game. Every gladiator is unique. Every death is permanent. Every victory reshapes your path.

⚔️ Core Gameplay

  • Train and manage your own stable of gladiators with distinct stats, traits, and skills.

  • Observe real-time battles where tactics, equipment, and morale matter more than luck.

  • Recruit wisely from slave markets, dungeons, and rival schools.

  • Survive and adapt — once a gladiator dies in the arena, they’re gone for good.

  • Climb the ranks from unknown lanista to imperial champion.

📜 Legacy Systems

  • Retire legendary fighters to your Hall of Fame.

  • Compete in multi-round tournaments for high rewards.

  • Boost training with specialized trainers and gear.

  • Invest in long-term strategies — not all victories come in the arena.

Gladiator Command is built for players who crave meaningful choices, unforgiving stakes, and the slow-burning satisfaction of building power from nothing.

Every battle is your test. Every decision writes history.

short_description: Manage your own gladiator school in a brutal, strategic auto-battler. Train, equip, and sacrifice warriors in permadeath arena combat. Build a legacy, rise through the ranks, and dominate ancient Rome or die trying.
